name: dsh-html-render
description: Inline HTML + KaTeX renderer for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) chats — sandboxed iframes, theme-adaptive, height-accurate, zero network.

scripts.check: node --check dsh-html-client.js && node --check install.mjs && node tools/check-version.mjs && node tools/verify-sha256sums.mjs vendor/katex/SHA256SUMS vendor/katex && node tools/check-mount-refs.mjs && node --check bundle/lib/client.js && node --check bundle/lib/index.js
